name: Grenke AG
summary: Grenke AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services to small and medium-sized (SME) enterprises in Germany, France, Italy, and internationally. It is involved in the financing for commercial lessees; leasing, services, protection, and maintenance offers, as well as small-ticket leasing of IT products, such as PCs, notebooks, servers, monitors, and other peripheral devices.
